plain: Roswell, New Mexico is where a crash in 1947 is said by many to have involved something not of this world. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that John Brennan and James Clapper, who were President Obama's CIA director and his director of national intelligence, appeared in a film talking about Roswell as real, and about a being who survived the crash. If true, it would mean former top spy chiefs are hinting the crash story is genuine.
